responsibility: This header defines GCC’s representation of atomic memory-ordering models used by __atomic and legacy sync builtins. It declares the memmodel enum values, the SYNC flag and masks for separating base ordering from target extensions, and inline predicates and conversion helpers for testing relaxed/acquire/release/acq_rel/seq_cst properties. It is the common compiler-side vocabulary for atomic ordering throughout front ends, middle end, and RTL expansion.
